comparison.objective: Remove a connector terminal; record fits and hand-tightens an oxygen regulator.
comparison.physical_skill: Fine latch release and extraction versus yoke placement over a valve, dual-pin alignment, face seating, and torque-controlled screw tightening.
comparison.success_condition: Terminal out with connector intact versus regulator seated, aligned, tightened to at least 0.75 N·m, released, and still, with tip/drop safety gates. Candidate force/damage thresholds are missing.
comparison.reason: The record tests keyed installation and torque closure rather than depinning.
